description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android Tic Tac Toe app. It manages the user interface components, rendering the game board, handling user interactions, accessibility features, animations, and observing the game state through a ViewModel.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Tic Tac Toe game, managing UI rendering, user interactions, accessibility, and game state observation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, focus order, event handlers, and observes game state.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the game board UI, including cell symbols, animations for new marks, and highlighting winning lines.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status text and color based on current game state, turn, or outcome.

methods.name: maybeShowOutcome
methods.description: Displays an outcome dialog if the game has concluded, announces results, and handles restart.

methods.name: announceForAccessibility
methods.description: Announces messages for accessibility services to inform users via screen readers.

methods.name: rowFromIndex
methods.description: Calculates the row number (1-based) from a board index.

methods.name: colFromIndex
methods.description: Calculates the column number (1-based) from a board index.
